coverageContext: Complete 288-variant Han Chinese pulmonary-embolism research score, distinct from the installed broader venous-thromboembolism models. Study testing used 646 cases/8810 controls after a separate discovery sample; the SNP p-value threshold was selected for the largest testing AUC, so reported AUROC0.765 is not an untouched external validation or GA performance. The primary paper describes top10% versus30-70% OR5.08; the Catalog quantile label is inconsistent and is not used to assign personal risk. GA retains only the original genetic sum, without study standardization. EUR rank withheld; transferability outside the evaluated population is unestablished. Not evidence for a current clot, future absolute probability, anticoagulant choice or emergency-care decision; low genetic scores cannot rule out pulmonary embolism.
